[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 480
- Description: Sophia Repo-Access Denylist — retire master allowlist for default-allow + two protected classes (PR1–PR6)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/1033
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/432
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/434
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/435
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/436
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1086
  
  Details:
  Executed `plans/SOPHIA_REPO_ACCESS_DENYLIST_PLAN.md` end-to-end: inverted the autopilot write model from a hand-maintained master `allowed_repos` allowlist (every new subdomain required a code edit + PR + deploy) to DEFAULT-ALLOW with two protected classes and a pattern-gated repo creation, plus a fail-soft audit log that restores the observability the allowlist gave for free.
  
  WHAT SHIPPED (6 units, truesight_autopilot + agentic_ai_context):
  - PR1 #1033 — plan + HANDOFF_MANIFEST row; §5d pre-flight measured live (git SSH key is org-wide so allowed_repos was advisory, not the true boundary).
  - PR2 #432 — config: default-allow write model; `strict_repos` (ALLOWED_REPOS env = fail-safe re-tighten), `create_repo_patterns` blessed globs (*-site, *-beta, *-prod, cfr-*, *-program, *-cache, *-raw); `repo_write_allowed` / `create_repo_allowed` / `repo_upload_allowed` helpers; protected classes (api_only_repos, prod_repos) checked FIRST so they hold in both modes.
  - PR3 #434 — rewired every guard site onto the new model; `create_repo` now pattern-gated instead of pre-listed-name (the recurring subdomain friction); prod/api-only refusals unchanged.
  - PR4 #435 — `app/repo_access_audit.py`: every default-allowed write appends a record (repo, action, result, strict vs default-allow mode) to ecosystem_change_logs/repo_access/ + manifest feed; fail-soft (audit hiccup never fails the write it records); self-disabling under pytest and when no PAT. Hooks in git_tools, upload_file_to_github, github_tools (create_repo / merge_pr / mark_pr_ready), main.py inline merge_pr, fix_agent, beta_deploy.
  - PR5 #436 — de-drift: rewrote app/context.py REPO CLASSES prompt text + git_tools schema string + main.py janitor log so the prose the model reads matches the enforced code (no behavior change).
  - PR6 #1086 — docs: new "Repo access model — default-allow + two protected classes (2026-09)" section in agentic_ai_context/references/GITHUB_AGENTIC_AI_SSH.md; fixed two stale Enforcement notes; tracked the plan trackers (marker + manifest row); filed OPEN_FOLLOWUPS Pending entry for Phase-2 credential narrowing.
  
  VERIFICATION: local gate on each code PR (compileall + ruff check + ruff format --check + pytest; final suite 1018 passed, 1 skipped, 4 xfailed, 3 xpassed — the 5 test_resolve_tdg_issued.py failures are pre-existing on clean main); CI green on every PR before merge.
  
  FOLLOW-UP (gated, not done): deploy_autopilot — PR3–PR5 are merged but NOT deployed, so the running box predates the new model + audit hook. Held pending Gary's explicit GO. PR7 (Phase-2 credential narrowing: per-repo GitHub App / deploy keys) filed in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.
  
  Design note: the master list was never the true boundary — the credential (org-wide SSH key / PAT) was; default-allow simply stops pretending otherwise and replaces the latent gap with explicit policy + an audit trail.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 800.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
